final_netlist:
.subckt dut iin vout vdd vss ibias
* --- 3-tap bias divider: vcn ~0.8 V, vcp ~0.35 V, ~0.5 uA ---
R1  vdd vcn 2.0meg
R2  vcn vcp 900k
R3  vcp vss 700k
Cvcn vcn vss 2p
Cvcp vcp vss 2p
* --- current-reuse cascoded inverter gain stage (IREF + boost current) ---
Rboost vdd ibias 75k
Cs  ibias vss 20p
MP  b   iin ibias ibias pfet W=14 L=0.35
MPC x   vcp b     vdd   pfet W=10 L=0.15
MNC x   vcn a     vss   nfet W=5  L=0.15
MN  a   iin vss   vss   nfet W=7  L=0.35
* --- feedback network (from high-Z node x) ---
Rf  x iin 600k
Cf  x iin 0.3f
* --- PMOS source follower output buffer, body tied to source ---
MSF vss x vout vout pfet W=10 L=0.15
RL  vdd vout 45k
.ends
